ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity (black) dominates approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with high intensity (white) localized to the distal tips and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) contiguous mass across central and proximal fluke. High-intensity (white) geometric patches at distal tips (left tip roughly 10% area, right tip roughly 15% area). Intermittent white linear streaks distributed across the black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the boundary. Peaks are more pronounced and jagged on the distal third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending laterally, transitioning to a sharp terminal turn at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast brownish-white pixels concentrated along the leading edges and at the extreme distal tips, exhibiting irregular circular geometries.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks). Left lobe features two parallel diagonal lines; right lobe features a complex network of intersecting linear marks of varying lengths.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of extensive white rake marks across the black pigmentation and heavy encrustation (potential barnacles) at the terminal points of both lobes.
